description: an elliptic column of semi-axes a on x and b on y, extruded Hz along z, fused with a plate 2·Lx by 2·Ly by 2·t that the column runs through: the plate's caps z = ±t cut the column's wall in two whole ellipses and its sides stand clear of it, so the elliptic-cylinder face is an operand face whose sections are exact conics crossing its seam (ADR-0014) and whose (u, v) regions stay rectangles. The volume is the column outside the plate plus the plate whole, π·a·b·(Hz − 2t) + 8·Lx·Ly·t; the area wants the perimeter of an ellipse, which the recipe grammar cannot say, so the oracle holds it

analytic.volume: pi * a * b * (Hz - 2 * t) + 8 * Lx * Ly * t
